linear_evidence.project: Ambitions Source Atlas Final Form Buildout
linear_evidence.document: Ambitions Source Atlas Final Form - Product, Architecture, Runtime, R2, and Validation Design
linear_evidence.current_interpretation: Completed project state is bounded/Yellow for overall Source Atlas release: stable-channel/API governance and configured production proof exist; full app/runtime/release launch floor is not claimed.
laws: Source Atlas/R2 are public/reference/freshness infrastructure only.
Private Life Runtime owns private context, personalization, pathing, schedules, Steps, proof, receipts, and local life graph.
R2 must not receive private goals, captures, schedules, proof, receipts, personalization, behavior history, inferred priorities, account IDs, device IDs, or private graph.
Source Atlas may provide public shards, requirements, constraints, proof needs, starter actions, source caveats, freshness, and risk metadata.
Source Atlas must not claim final personalized plans, final schedules, or final Steps.

public_reference_shards_1m.gap: No canonical shard counter or million-shard corpus exists; generated files and R2 objects are bounded configured-frontier evidence only.

goal_domains_500.gap: Current production/frontier proof covers 14 configured domains, not a 500-domain taxonomy.

subdomains_5000.gap: No accepted subdomain taxonomy/counter exists; source-lane scopes are not a launch-floor subdomain universe.

golden_goal_intents_50000.gap: Representative and native stress fixtures exist, but no 50,000 adjudicated golden-intent corpus or coverage ledger is present.

source_needed_fallback_under_5_percent.gap: No lawful-goal evaluation universe, missing-shard denominator, or continuous fallback-rate metric is installed.

continuous_source_expansion_pipeline.target: Continuous source expansion pipeline for every missing-shard event
continuous_source_expansion_pipeline.gap: Missing-shard events do not yet durably execute registry mutation, harvest, claim extraction, pack compilation, R2 promotion, native activation, and regression measurement for every event.

universal_goal_domain_router.answer: No. The repo has a governed configured-domain router plus candidate-only intake for unknown lawful public/reference domains, not a universal 500-domain launch router.
evidence: docs/qa/source-atlas/source-atlas-goal-domain-gauntlet-train-131.json proves 14 configured cases and 3 unknown probes candidate-only; it blocks literal universal coverage.

missing_domain_candidate_only_routing.answer: Yes for bounded public/reference unknown-domain handling.
evidence: goal-domain-gauntlet Train 131 records 3 unknown probes and candidate-only routing.
arbitrary_goal_domain_gate.py blocks private-looking input and routes unknown lawful public/reference domains into candidate intake without final outputs.

autonomous_source_expansion.answer: Partial. Candidate-domain and missing-domain chains exist, but they intentionally stop before registry mutation, claim publication, R2 promotion, and native activation.
evidence: docs/qa/source-atlas/source-atlas-autonomous-domain-expansion-chain-train-107.md records 1 candidate input, work orders, review markers, 0 claims, 0 R2, 0 native.
tools/source-atlas/foundry/autonomous_domain_expansion_chain.py emits work/review packets rather than mutating canonical registries.

production_supervision_maintenance.answer: Partial. Supervision/maintenance exists for the 14 configured domains, with production writes held behind explicit execute/approval gates.
evidence: docs/qa/source-atlas/source-atlas-autonomous-production-supervisor-train-133-proof-refresh.md records 14 maintenance snapshots and 0 production writes.
docs/qa/source-atlas/source-atlas-autonomous-control-loop-train-131.md records run/hold decisions and no live harvest/R2 writes.

native_runtime_bridge_to_private_runtime.answer: Partial foundation only. Native refresh/cache/verification and Source Atlas bridge models exist, but launch-floor proof does not show verified public shards feeding the production Private Runtime planner path end-to-end.
evidence: Native/Ambitions/Core/LocalRuntimeOS/SourceAtlas/SourceAtlasPublicPackFetchPipeline.swift proves manifest/pack/cache/LKG/quarantine pipeline behavior in focused tests.
Generated native-runtime proof is bounded to 14 configured domains and explicitly does not claim final user plans/schedules/Steps or app-wide release readiness.

what_prevents_launch_floor_near_universa: Only 14 configured domains/frontiers are production-ledger ready, far below 500 domains and 5,000 subdomains.
No canonical one-million-shard corpus, shard counter, index layout, or R2 scale proof exists.
No 50,000 adjudicated golden goal-intent corpus exists.
No measured fallback denominator/numerator exists for the <5% lawful-goal fallback target.
Continuous expansion is candidate/review/supervisor scaffolding, not a closed-loop registry-to-R2-to-native execution pipeline for every missing shard.
Native proof is bounded and does not show production planner consumption of verified shards at launch scale.
Legal/API/source-lane expansion and external release gates remain outside current proof.

main_gap_classification.architecture: partial gap: abstractions exist, but launch-floor counters, taxonomy, million-shard partitioning, and native production handoff are not fully installed
main_gap_classification.automation: partial gap: dry-run/audit/supervision exist; continuous execute path for missing-shard events is not installed
main_gap_classification.source_lane_execution: major gap: 34 lanes/34 sources are far below near-universal source coverage and require legal/API execution expansion
main_gap_classification.shard_count: major gap: current generated/R2 evidence is orders of magnitude below 1M shards
main_gap_classification.test_scale: major gap: no 50k golden-intent suite or fallback metric
main_gap_classification.storage_index_r2_layout: major gap: current R2 inventory is 196 objects and does not prove 1M-shard layout/readback/load/rollback
main_gap_classification.product_law_overclaim_gating: not a gap to remove: existing law correctly prevents private-data/final-plan/release overclaims and should remain unchanged

required_changes.title: Install a launch-floor coverage ledger with canonical counters
files_must_change: tools/source-atlas/tests/*completion* or new launch-floor ledger tests
required_changes.required_change: Add canonical metrics for shard_count, domain_count, subdomain_count, golden_intent_count, fallback numerator/denominator, missing-shard event backlog, and continuous-expansion state.
required_changes.risk_if_omitted: Launch-floor status remains narrative and cannot be safely gated or regressed.

required_changes.title: Build the 500-domain / 5,000-subdomain public taxonomy and router scale path
required_changes.required_change: Replace the bounded 14-domain frontier with a versioned taxonomy and router admission model that can prove 500 domains and 5,000 subdomains without accepting private goal text.
required_changes.risk_if_omitted: Unknown lawful domains keep falling into candidate-only routing and universal coverage remains blocked.

required_changes.title: Define and validate the 1M+ public/reference shard corpus and R2/index layout
required_changes.required_change: Add shard identity/versioning, partition/index manifests, bulk compile/validate, readback, checksum, revocation, load, rollback, and native decoder compatibility proof at million-shard scale.
required_changes.risk_if_omitted: R2/gateway evidence stays small and cannot support public launch claims.

required_changes.title: Create the 50,000-intent golden gauntlet and <5% fallback metric
required_changes.required_change: Add adjudicated lawful-goal intent corpus, domain/subdomain balance, source-needed fallback labels, native-runtime permutations, and regression thresholds.
required_changes.risk_if_omitted: The <5% fallback target is unmeasurable and launch coverage can be overclaimed.

required_changes.title: Close the continuous missing-shard expansion loop
required_changes.required_change: Persist every missing-shard event, route it through review/legal/API gates, mutate approved registries, harvest, extract, adjudicate, pack, promote, verify R2, activate native registry, and re-run fallback metrics.
required_changes.risk_if_omitted: Candidate-only routing accumulates backlog instead of reducing fallback coverage.

required_changes.title: Expand source-lane legal/API governance for public launch scale
required_changes.required_change: Add lane ownership, rate limits, license review states, expiry/renewal, provenance requirements, lane-to-domain/subdomain coverage, and legal approval references for expanded public/reference sources.
required_changes.risk_if_omitted: The corpus cannot lawfully scale and stale/API-unsafe sources can enter launch packs.

required_changes.title: Wire verified Source Atlas packs into production Private Runtime pathing locally
required_changes.required_change: Add a production local provider/handoff from verified public packs to Private Runtime planning candidates with receipts, replay, privacy egress assertions, offline fallback, and no final-plan/final-schedule/Step overclaims.
required_changes.risk_if_omitted: Native runtime remains Source Atlas-capable in tests but not launch-floor proven for real planning pathing.

required_changes.title: Add R2/gateway production-scale readback, rollback, and promotion gates
required_changes.required_change: Prove staged/promoted objects, manifest indexes, hash/signature readback, revocation, rollback, gateway allowlist, no-private-data scans, and scale limits for 1M+ shards.
required_changes.risk_if_omitted: Small-object live inventory remains useful but insufficient for launch R2 posture.

required_changes.title: Keep product-law and release-proof gates blocking overclaims
files_must_change: docs/truth/PRODUCT_DESIGN_TRUTH.md should not change for launch-floor execution unless canon itself changes
docs/truth/PRODUCT_EXPERIENCE_CANON.md should not change for launch-floor execution unless canon itself changes
docs/qa/source-atlas/source-atlas-release-proof-packet-train-132.json should be superseded by new proof, not weakened
required_changes.required_change: Preserve public/reference-only boundaries and no final personalized plan/schedule/Step claims; add proof only when real external validation exists.
required_changes.risk_if_omitted: The project can make unsafe privacy, release, or product claims.

required_changes.title: Normalize proof-train hygiene and regenerated evidence provenance
required_changes.required_change: Fix stale in-document train labels, record command lines, HEAD, dirty-state, and generated-output status so future audits can distinguish current proof from retained evidence.
required_changes.risk_if_omitted: Auditors can confuse retained historical proof with current launch-floor evidence.

tools/source-atlas/tests/*completion* or new launch-floor ledger tests
